note: Accessory Bag powers. Nine of one Power Stone handed to Maxwell unlocks its power permanently, and the profile lists what you already have under accessory_bag_storage.unlocked_powers.
source: https://hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Power_Stones for the stone-to-power mapping and the nine-per-power rule. Item ids are resolved from the Hypixel items resource by name at build time, so a rename can't silently mis-key a stone.
verified: The nine-per-power rule and the fact that unlocking grants SkyBlock XP are both stated by the wiki. The XP amount is NOT: the wiki records only that the January 2023 update started granting it, and no power unlock appears in the API's completed-task vocabulary to read a figure off. 15 is the user's recollection and is the one number here nothing independent backs.
